categories.label: Front office
categories.summary: Coverage, authorization, estimates, deposits and the cash drawer.

pages.label: Billing home
pages.summary: Today across every queue.

pages.label: Patient and encounter coverage
pages.summary: Verify each patient’s insurance before services are billed. Unverified coverage cannot be used for claims.

pages.label: Payer authorizations
pages.summary: Request and track prior authorization. A partial approval records the approved amount for the claim.

pages.label: Eligibility checks
pages.summary: Real-time eligibility against the payer. Results come from the simulator in this environment.

pages.label: Estimates and admission clearance
pages.summary: Give patients a cost estimate and clear admission once the required deposit is held. Overrides need a second person.

pages.label: Deposits
pages.summary: Money held against an encounter. Apply it to invoices, or request a transfer or refund for a second person to approve.

pages.label: Cash drawer
pages.summary: Open and close cashier drawers. Variances beyond the tolerance go to a supervisor for review.

categories.label: Charges and documents
categories.summary: From captured charge to issued invoice and its notes.

pages.label: Unbilled worklist
pages.summary: Encounters with charges not yet invoiced. Mark ready, hold with a reason, or create the invoice draft from priced charges.

pages.label: Charge detail
pages.summary: Every captured charge line. Price from the catalogue, reprice with a reason, send to review or reverse.

pages.label: Manual charges and procedure groups
pages.summary: Fees that no clinical order produces. Each needs approval by a second person before it becomes a charge.

pages.label: Invoices
pages.summary: Draft invoices are issued by someone other than the person who drafted them. Issued invoices never change; corrections use notes.

pages.label: Debit notes
pages.summary: Increase what is owed on an issued invoice, for example a late charge. Issued by a second person.

pages.label: Credit notes
pages.summary: Reduce what is owed on an issued invoice. Never more than the open balance; approved by a second person.

pages.label: Adjustments
pages.summary: Contractual allowances, small-balance and bad-debt write-offs. Every write-off is decided by a second person.

categories.label: Money
categories.summary: Receipts, allocation, refunds and prepaid packages.

pages.label: Receipts and allocation
pages.summary: Record money received and allocate it to open invoices. Voids need a second person and only apply to unallocated receipts.

pages.label: Refunds and payouts
pages.summary: Approve refunds, dispatch them to the payout provider and confirm the outcome. The simulator never moves real money.

pages.label: Packages
pages.summary: Prepaid service packages. Record sessions as they are used; cancelling refunds the unused share less the fee.

categories.label: Insurance
categories.summary: Claims, exchange, remittances, appeals and payer balances.

pages.label: Claims
pages.summary: Every payer claim from ready to paid. Submission through the exchange creates a tracked message.

pages.label: Exchange monitor
pages.summary: Live view of messages to and from payers. Retry failures or resolve them manually with a reason.

pages.label: Remittances
pages.summary: Payer remittance advice. Posting updates every claim and invoice it covers, so it is checked by a second person.

pages.label: Remittance corrections
pages.summary: Correct a keying or payer error on a posted remittance line. The difference is applied to the invoice on approval.

pages.label: Appeals
pages.summary: Contest denials before the filing deadline. Filing is approved by a second person; outcomes record what was recovered.

pages.label: Payer reconciliation
pages.summary: Compare what each payer should have paid with what arrived, period by period. Sign-off is independent.

pages.label: Responsibility transfers
pages.summary: Move a balance between payer levels or to the patient. Approval moves the money and bills the new party.

categories.label: Receivables
categories.summary: Aging, plans, statements, collections and reporting.

pages.label: Aging
pages.summary: Open balances by age and party.

pages.label: Payment plans
pages.summary: Instalment agreements for patient balances. Approval generates the schedule; payments reduce it in order.

pages.label: Statements
pages.summary: Patient statements generated each cycle. Send them, record returned mail, or suppress for a reason.

pages.label: Dunning and collections
pages.summary: Overdue patient balances move through reminders to a final notice. Agency referral needs a second person.

pages.label: Reports
pages.summary: Revenue cycle performance.

categories.label: Coding and models
categories.summary: Coding, clinical clarification, grouping and model settlements.

pages.label: Coding worklist
pages.summary: Assign diagnosis and procedure codes. Coding is validated by a second coder before billing uses it.

pages.label: CDI clarifications
pages.summary: Clinical documentation questions to clinicians. Answers return to the coder; unanswered queries escalate.

pages.label: DRG grouping
pages.summary: Run the licensed grouper on coded inpatient stays and validate the result before claims use it.

pages.label: E&M determinations
pages.summary: Determine the visit level from medical decision making or time. A second person confirms or overrides it.

pages.label: Model settlements
pages.summary: Capitation, bundle, budget and performance settlements per contract period, posted to the ledger after approval.

categories.label: Accounting
categories.summary: Journals, exceptions, reconciliation and ERP exports.

pages.label: Journals and exceptions
pages.summary: Balanced journals produced by billing events. Missing GL mappings stop posting and appear here as exceptions.

pages.label: GL reconciliation
pages.summary: Match subledger balances to the general ledger for each control account and period.

pages.label: Exports
pages.summary: Batches of posted journals for the ERP. Each batch is approved before export and carries a checksum.

categories.label: Cross-cutting
categories.summary: Approvals, workflow tasks and assistance suggestions.

pages.label: Approvals inbox
pages.summary: Everything waiting for a second person.

pages.label: Workflow worklist
pages.summary: Checkpoint tasks from claim, appeal, coding and collection workflows. Pick one up, block it with a reason, or finish it.

pages.label: Assistance
pages.summary: Suggestions from operational assistance. They never change records; a person accepts or dismisses each one.
